summary.text: Spencer Gosch is a Republican state representative from District 23 who returned to the House in January 2025 after earlier service from 2017 to 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small business owner who also works on his family farm.

paragraphs.text: Spencer Gosch attended the University of South Dakota, and Ballotpedia says his professional experience includes working as a small business owner and working on his family farm.
He represented South Dakota House District 23 from 2017 to 2023 and assumed office again on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session, Gosch is vice chair of the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and serves on the House State Affairs Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
